**Result:** Controller qualified on ALOHA-2 #5, insertion task — 3/3 required successful autonomous trials achieved within the 5 allowed starts (trial times 87 s, 84 s, 64 s; final trial inserted the peg to the hole bottom, tip at z = 15 mm vs. socket top z = 55 mm, i.e. the full 40 mm depth).
